landing.tagline: Not an AI. Just humans talking.
landing.lead: It looks like a modern AI chatbot. But every reply you get is genuinely typed by a human — no model, no hidden API key.
landing.step1_title: Sign up with an active WhatsApp number
landing.step1_desc: So an operator can confirm you're a real human too.
landing.step2_desc: No AI is thinking up the answer — a human genuinely has to read it first.
landing.step3_title: Get a reply from an operator
landing.step3_desc: It can be slow if the operator is resting — they're human, after all.
landing.footer: HumanAI v1.0.0 — built by Orbit Studio.
